name: Hintertuxer Gletscher
kurzbeschreibung: Hintertuxer Gletscher up to 3,250 m altitude is Austria's only year-round ski resort featuring the Natur Eis Palast and Spannagelhöhle.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hintertuxer Gletscher at the head of the Zillertal valley's Tuxertal is the only ski area in Austria open 365 days a year. Rising to a snow-reliable altitude of 3,250 meters at the foot of the mighty Olperer (3,476 m), state-of-the-art cable car installations open up the fascinating realm of eternal ice. The glacier serves not only as a training center for national alpine ski teams from around the world, but is also a spectacular destination for mountain hikers, families, and geology enthusiasts.

Natur Eis Palast & Spannagelhöhle

Tourism development of the Tuxer Ferner began in 1968 with the construction of the first double chairlifts; today, the wind-stable funitel ropeways Gletscherbus 1, 2 und 3 carry visitors comfortably in around 45 minutes from Hintertux (1,500 m) to the Gefrorene Wand at 3,250 meters. Two globally unique natural wonders distinguish the glacier domain: directly adjacent to the top station of Gletscherbus 3 lies the Natur Eis Palast: a natural glacier crevasse accessible year-round at 3,250 meters, featuring colossal ice crystals, frozen waterfalls, and an underground glacier lake on which guided raft tours take place (constant 0 °C inside). Around 600 meters lower, at the Tuxer Fernerhaus at 2,530 meters altitude, lies the entrance to the Spannagelhöhle: with over 13 kilometers of explored passages, it is the largest show cave in the entire Central Alps and the highest marble cave in Europe. Guided cave tours reveal stalactites, glacial potholes, and glittering crystals deep inside the mountain massif.

Visit & Getting There

The Hintertuxer Gletscher operates 365 days a year. Cable car operating hours: daily from 08:15 to 16:30. Natur Eis Palast: guided tours daily every hour from 10:30 to 14:30 (no advance booking required; tickets adults approx. €39.00, children 6–14 years approx. €15.00). Spannagelhöhle: guided tours daily on the hour from 10:00 to 15:00 (summer; admission incl. equipment adults approx. €26.50, children approx. €15.00). Pedestrian panorama ticket for the glacier lifts (Gletscherbus 1–3 up to 3,250 m, 2025/2026 season): adults approx. €52.00, children approx. €26.00. Arrival by car: Inntal motorway A12, exit Zillertal, take the B169 to Mayrhofen and continue on the Tuxer Landesstraße L6 to the large lift car park in Hintertux. By public transport: Zillertalbahn to Mayrhofen station, from where the regional Tuxer Sportbus runs frequently direct to the valley station of the glacier lifts.

Tips

The modern gondolas of Gletscherbus 1 to 3 and the panorama terrace at 3,250 meters are barrier-free and offer a breathtaking view reaching from the Großglockner to the Zugspitze. For visiting the Natur Eis Palast and the Spannagelhöhle, ankle-high mountain boots and warm clothing are strictly required (for safety reasons, children under 6 years are not permitted on the cave tours).
